raw_text: India apparently tracked a Chinese nuclear sub in the Bay of Bengal for 3 days. Type 093A Shang-class. Used P-8I and an ASW corvette. This is huge if true — shows both PLAN's expanding reach and India's ASW capability. The Bay of Bengal is supposed to be India's domain. Chinese SSNs operating there is a game changer.
